title: Thread encoder capability facts into wizard
summary: Thread read-only FFmpeg encoder-list capability facts into the Settings wizard hardware probe and WebView result rendering.
reason: Phase 6 needs Python/UI capability evidence before broader hardware encoder activation, while keeping settings choices portable and dormant encoder families disabled.
behavior_before: The Settings wizard hardware probe returned detected encoder names plus NVENC and CPU fallback lists, but it did not expose descriptor-aligned video capability facts or backend availability rows for the WebView to annotate.
behavior_after: The Settings wizard hardware probe now derives video-only EncodingCapabilityFacts and backend availability rows from the configured FFmpeg encoder list, and the WebView renders capability facts, hardware backend, and CPU fallback annotations without filtering or removing settings choices.
rollback_plan: Remove the Settings wizard capability-fact helper and backend rows, remove the WebView hardware-probe annotation rows, revert the focused test assertions and docs wording, then refresh generated summaries.
